name: ViP_1 Low-Level Image Processing Benchmark
description: Measures performance of low-level image processing algorithms on the ViP_1 parallel processor, focusing on throughput, efficiency, and correctness.
evaluation_method: throughput / latency / correctness (e.g., FPS, execution_time, PSNR/SSIM)
general_score_metric: throughput (FPS) and correctness metrics such as PSNR / SSIM
reputation: A niche, hardware-oriented benchmark historically used to evaluate low-level image processing on the ViP_1 parallel processor; limited relevance to modern general-purpose VLM/LLM evaluation.
notes: Hardware- and implementation-specific (outdated for modern accelerators), non-LLM benchmark; results are highly platform-dependent and not directly comparable to contemporary vision benchmarks.
